method.application: Actual main/preload/typed IPC, serialized atomic LocalState storage and current renderer code in protected fresh dummy-account profiles. Hidden muted windows and owned localhost catalog. Shared provider Keychain adapter substituted. All non-fixture external requests blocked; zero provider requests in all five cases.
method.productionRenderer: Two changed-profile cases use the unchanged current production renderer bundle. Hold a Save before main handler entry or immediately before actual LocalState update, navigate to music and back, confirm mood and profile controls remain locked, switch active profile through actual typed IPC, then release old save. Neither profile changes, the old draft remains and the main guard returns an actionable error. The profile change is a controlled main-boundary stimulus, not a claim that disabled UI permits switching.
method.newerDraftRenderer: Three cases build the actual current renderer source with a test-only reference exposing the existing SessionContent root draft getter/setter. No mutation/query/save logic is replaced. Actual UI submits a setup save, while the test holds its IPC reply after durable publication or its actual temporary-file rename before a controlled write failure. After native music navigation and lock checks, inject newer source/host/mood/interests/workflow/stop-error state through the real setter. Both old success and failure retain every newer field; error survives navigation; a later explicit UI Save commits the newer draft. This is controlled concurrency stress beyond what locked UI currently allows.
method.storage: Success hold occurs after actual handler has committed. Failure holds after writing the temporary LocalState file but before rename; the old on-disk profile remains, and actual atomic writer throws. Production main sanitizes the unexpected error and renderer shows explicit retry. No production file operation is replaced.
method.accountTransition: Hold an actual save before commit. Native Settings confirmation signs out; native dummy sign-in and actual library selection enter a second account. Inject its newer draft through the exposed real setter, then release the old save. Final epoch guard rejects the write; old root setter/error callback cannot touch the new SessionContent. Persisted mood stays unchanged and the new session shows no old sign-out error.
method.cleanup: Each app.close is followed by assertion that the isolated captured-fatal file is absent. Final matrix driver terminates zero; no individual Electron process exit-code claim. Owned server terminates and control file resets.
